verdict.rationale: Docs mention SSO and role-based access controls for managing org/project access (llamaparse-docs-9, llamaparse-docs-18), but there is no evidence of scoped or least-privilege API key/credential issuance specifically for agents (e.g., per-key permission scopes, agent-specific tokens). This is a fair axis for an API platform, so absence of evidence yields 'none' rather than 'na'.
